# Environment contract

The opening pilot uses:

- R 4.4.1
- Quarto 1.9.38
- the package versions recorded in `renv.lock`

Article 09 adds a deliberately small, executed Linux-platform environment:

- `platform-smoke.yml`
- environment name `metagenome-platform-smoke-2026.07`
- Python 3.12.13
- SeqKit 2.10.0
- pigz 2.8
- Matplotlib 3.10.5

Its YAML SHA-256 is
`8f758b6ffdcf1561ece7d187ff34bc3f5a174fd8c6da66a101b206fcc869d20c`.
The 2026-07-19 native-Linux solve contains 71 packages and the corresponding
Linux-64 explicit specification is generated by
`scripts/validate_article09_environment.py`. This environment validates the
portable execution layer and real-data smoke contract only; it does not claim
that bioBakery, assembly, binning, MAG QC, or their databases are installed.

Article 10 reuses this exact environment for its Python validation and
Matplotlib figures. Its SLURM and Apptainer sections are syntax/contract
audits plus a native local task-body smoke; no scheduler or current Apptainer
runtime is added to the conda environment or claimed as locally executed.

Article 11 adds two solved and directly invoked native-Linux environments:

- `biobakery.yml` and `biobakery-linux-64.lock`
- `assembly.yml` and `assembly-linux-64.lock`

The assembly YAML directly pins Bowtie2 2.5.5 for Article 30 read-back
mapping. The package was already present in the frozen Linux-64 transaction
through CoverM, so promoting it to a direct dependency did not change the
explicit lock; its entry point was re-audited on 2026-07-26.

Their command entry points and packaged self-tests passed, but the large
MetaPhlAn, HUMAnN, CheckM2 and GTDB databases remain separately gated. An
installed executable is not evidence that a database-dependent sample
workflow has run.

Article 12 uses R 4.4.1, Bioconductor 3.19 and the 185-record `renv.lock`.

- FastQC 0.12.1
- fastp 1.3.6

The YAML SHA-256 is
`3d94a0e5e8a8b1ba2bf58de1d1c15be06824ae7163965559fce48ce632e94759`.

All three QC tools were actually run on the synchronized `ERR9765746`

Article 34 adds the paper-compatible gene-catalog environment:

- `gene-catalog.yml`
- `gene-catalog-linux-64.lock`
- environment name `metagenome-gene-catalog-2026.07`
- Prodigal 2.6.3
- MMseqs2 9.d36de, matching Delgado and Andersson (2022)
- CD-HIT 4.8.1, SeqKit 2.11.0, and Python 3.10.14

The YAML SHA-256 is
`c15dae716c13fb465cf7b4f52ac8ecf2962b0b2afc9f0514aaf3da8fa89d972c`.
The 2026-07-28 native-Linux explicit lock contains 47 package URLs and has
SHA-256
`b70bdcd6de539bb6ca5f29008f0b9d8f3460cc727d967c74bfdcba6b7b427dc5`.
The executed workflow uses Prodigal metagenomic mode and MMseqs2 protein
clustering at 95% amino-acid identity and 95% member coverage. CD-HIT is an
explicit method-sensitivity branch rather than an assumed drop-in equivalent.

Article 35 adds a read-to-gene quantification and protein-annotation environment:

- `gene-abundance.yml`
- `gene-abundance-linux-64.lock`
- environment name `metagenome-gene-abundance-2026.07`
- Bowtie2 2.5.5, SAMtools 1.23.1, HTSeq 2.1.2, seqtk 1.5
- DIAMOND 2.2.4 and Python 3.10.20
- NumPy 2.2.6, Matplotlib 3.10.9, and Pillow 12.3.0 for locked validation figures

The YAML SHA-256 is
`7a0280495b6712a6d590397e4876f13dd103112bfe14dba3f0687549f853874f`.
The 2026-07-28 native-Linux explicit lock contains 121 lines, including the
standard `@EXPLICIT` header, and has SHA-256
`91e495c6618400a829703bb2bea903d364de55f0a431f42f7cb5e134c2ef4c2d`.
The main alignment branch uses Bowtie2 local alignment with two reported
candidates and explicit MAPQ, identity, and query-coverage policies. Functional
annotation uses iterative sensitive DIAMOND search against the separately
managed 36.3-GB HUMAnN UniRef90 v201901b database; that database is not part of
the conda environment or Git repository.

- `eggnog-annotation-linux-64.lock`
- environment name `metagenome-eggnog-2026.07`
- eggNOG-mapper 2.1.15 and DIAMOND 2.0.15
- Python 3.11.9, NumPy 2.4.6, Matplotlib 3.10.1, and Pillow 10.3.0

The YAML SHA-256 is
`7931295cd72876a5cf61d6001301f38f05db3bb54dcebb7cd55ae029d1a8cf7d`.
The 2026-07-28 native-Linux explicit lock contains 105 lines, including the
standard `@EXPLICIT` header, and has SHA-256
`573e3f29d9e9fc033621346a4ee02812daaa89afd6918cff0c0caaeb2bd250b1`.
eggNOG 5.0.2 is managed separately from the conda environment: the manifest

Article 58 adds two deliberately separated microbial-eukaryote environments:

- `microbial-eukaryotes.yml` and `microbial-eukaryotes-linux-64.lock`
- environment name `metagenome-microbial-eukaryotes-2026.07`
- EukDetect conda package 2.0.2, Bowtie2 2.5.4, SAMtools 1.23,
  Snakemake 9.14.5, Python 3.13.11, pysam 0.23.3 and Biopython 1.86
- `eukrep-legacy.yml` and `eukrep-legacy-linux-64.lock`
- environment name `metagenome-eukrep-legacy-2026.07`
- EukRep 0.6.7, Python 3.6.15, scikit-learn 0.19.2, NumPy 1.19.5,
  SciPy 1.5.3 and the legacy libgfortran 3 runtime

The EukDetect YAML and 211-URL Linux explicit lock have SHA-256 values
`0e8c746c15f433b33b06b3d0f9d0c8a0a77fe3ea50d6d5aaa49457da6807977c`
and
`aa66717f7bcc0625ba04ea3fceac32a31064194388aada9572757da5a1f93a68`,
respectively. The hash-locked `legacy-cgi` pip requirements file has SHA-256
`df65d2dfa46092559a8ded13fc807704cc8ecd51f9e73b942935950e1428c100`.
The EukRep YAML and 56-URL explicit lock have SHA-256 values
`fd978527e740a4c42a71e578cfbadda19f48c62fca17fa4a81cc21c1e8fc8b28`
and
`86b1d9c98545b1495273e93f144670f49a2da202cc2dfa99559977d6867fbc4d`.
EukRep remains isolated because its published model depends on the old
scikit-learn serialization stack. The installed EukDetect conda record reports
2.0.2, Python distribution metadata reports 2.0.0, and its CLI banner reports
v2.0.1; Article 58 records all three values explicitly. The
7,123,869,920-byte database release dated 2026-03-16
(Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19056625) is checksum-gated separately and is not
part of either conda environment or the Git repository.

The DRAM YAML and 216-line Linux explicit lock have SHA-256 values
`c652f4bbdab1227119689e256d41176ee2585801721dfa31f6bda875d954b8f7`
and
`95921ffb957cc9f161c9c2fd57ce1cde236a88845a68cacdc5ae7306921e53c0`.
The METABOLIC YAML and 132-line Linux explicit lock have SHA-256 values
`a9b709506498982050e533b12ebdeab988993a4958f46589d0aa17c7a591d841`
and
`a32c671d3c1df8f245e8a66d6df9e07894f9de59703b9138c1f13de1cbe6959e`.
DRAM 1.5.0 still imports the deprecated `pkg_resources` API, so setuptools is
locked to 80.10.2. All DRAM entry points are invoked with
`PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1`; this prevents user-level Python packages from overriding
the explicit environment lock. KOfam, dbCAN and MEROPS databases remain
separately checksum-gated and are not included in either environment or Git.

Article 60 adds two isolated genome-scale metabolic reconstruction environments:

- `gapseq.yml` and `gapseq-linux-64.lock`
- environment name `metagenome-gapseq-2026.08`
- gapseq 2.1.0, R 4.5.3, cobrar 0.2.5, DIAMOND 2.2.4, GLPK 5.0,
  HMMER 3.4, BLAST 2.17.0, pyrodigal 3.7.1 and libSBML 5.21.1

- environment name `metagenome-carveme-2026.08`
- CarveMe 1.6.6, Python 3.12.13, DIAMOND 2.1.13, reframed 1.6.0,
  PySCIPOpt 6.2.1, SCIP 10.0.3 and python-libSBML 5.21.1

The gapseq YAML and Linux explicit lock have SHA-256 values
`7fdc6f8b72ab3aed4b6e3249fa8ccc8ce3a45ae8661500e8055edc557144b019`
and
`01a46d2f816345a25eaedc440bac33dd4b7eed6f356cdf06982a16652f1d5978`.
The CarveMe YAML and Linux explicit lock have SHA-256 values
`f740173ededb1498f1fcfece16b77a2c8ccd087c18e891951a880459dc7d5820`
and
`5995a492f7c247a2b8239df49f6ab79eb6c010773056704bda00bc150a35b7c8`.
The gapseq v1.5 sequence database (Zenodo 20446806) and CarveMe package
universes/DIAMOND database are separately checked against the seven-asset

CarveMe gap filling is applied with the independent `gapfill` command so that
the added-reaction set is not confounded by a second carving optimum.

Article 61 adds the executed community-metabolism environment:

- `community-metabolism.yml`
- `community-metabolism-linux-64.lock`
- `community-metabolism-pip.lock`
- environment name `metagenome-community-2026.08`

- SMETANA mixed-integer solver stack: reframed 1.6.0, PySCIPOpt 6.2.1 and
  SCIP 10.0.3
- Python 3.12.13, pandas 2.3.3, NumPy 2.5.1 and SciPy 1.18.0

The YAML, 83-line Linux conda explicit lock and complete PyPI lock have
SHA-256 values
`327cbf3718e4168a6f98ecc921a39fdf7556b263c89daa83280383a167a491c3`,
`5995a492f7c247a2b8239df49f6ab79eb6c010773056704bda00bc150a35b7c8`,

`a30b3ce3236a7f2de4270481b2ba590d2a50b3f897a3bee2f7e467189ea199cc`,
respectively. The conda lock provides the compiled CarveMe/SCIP base and the
PyPI lock records every distribution installed on top, including MICOM and
SMETANA transitive dependencies. `pip check`, a MICOM hybrid-QP growth test,

The 264,422,408-byte AGORA 2.01 model database and dietary medium are managed
separately under the Article 61 resource manifest and are not included in the
environment or Git repository.
